title: The divided kingdom and the prophets
note: After Solomon died, ten northern tribes broke away as the kingdom of Israel, while the south, Judah, kept Jerusalem and David's line. Assyria conquered the north around 722 BC; Babylon destroyed Jerusalem around 586 BC. Prophets spoke God's word to kings and people through these centuries.
